# Miss Universe Scraps Upper Age Limit, A Game-Changing Move For Pageants
## In a historic move, the upper limit for contestants has been removed from the Miss Universe pageant.
In a revelation that shook the beauty pageant world, R'Bonney Gabriel, the current Miss Universe on Thursday, September 15th, 2023 announced that any females above the age of 28 will now be able to participate in the Miss Universe pageant.

...

Ever since the Miss Universe pageant started in 1952 the age limit for the participants has been 18 to 28 years.
R'Bonney, who is now 29 years old, set a new record of her own as the oldest contestant to be crowned Miss Universe when she won the pageant in 2022.

...

1. While the current age limit for Miss Universe is 28, it is 27 for Miss Word and 25 for Femina Miss India, the latter with a height restriction of 5 foot 3 and above.

...

In its 72-year history, Miss Universe crowned 40 young women between the ages of 17 to 20 years. Harnaaz Kaur Sandhu was 21 when she won the crown, one among 3 in the last 5 years who were under the age of 25.
It's no wonder, then, that R'Bonney, the oldest to win the title at 28, is all for breaking the age barriers of the pageant.
